rationale: The agent appears to have authenticated by looking up the user via name and ZIP and retrieved user and order details. However, it then executed an exchange on two delivered items in a single write call without first seeking explicit user confirmation, which violates the policy requirement to confirm every order-changing action. Additionally, the user’s stated conditional instruction (“If the agent asks for confirmation, only exchange the desk lamp”) implies only the lamp should have been exchanged upon confirmation; instead, the agent exchanged both the water bottle and the desk lamp. The agent also selected a payment method and completed the exchange without presenting a confirmation summary to the user. These constitute policy violations, so the outcome fails.
